title: Choosing Wisely: specialty-society overuse recommendations and patient-clinician conversation rail
summary: Promotes Choosing Wisely: specialty-society overuse recommendations and patient-clinician conversation rail as a de-adoption/practice-lag infrastructure record. The record is not an incident or trial record; it describes a rail by which negative evidence can become reviewable, discussable, recommended against, or translated into practice constraints.

type_payload.query_value: A low-value-care conversation rail that can connect negative evidence to patient/clinician-facing de-adoption prompts.

handling_notes: Clinical reversals can involve real patients who made choices under uncertainty; avoid hindsight contempt.
Do not treat procedure de-adoption as a patient-specific treatment recommendation.
Preserve the difference between “no benefit in studied population” and “never useful.”
